applicabilityBasis.summary: Ondo calls USDon a stablecoin backed 1:1 by U.S. dollars held in its brokerage accounts and describes its use for stock purchases and redemptions. That settlement use fits the GENIUS design/use limb, irrespective of a platform-only purpose or non-U.S. distribution. Public materials establish USDon/USDC conversion at 1:1 subject to swapper liquidity, but do not establish an issuer contractual obligation to redeem USDon for a fixed monetary value excluding another digital asset. Bank-wire U.S. dollar redemptions are expressly not currently supported. The published securities prospectus and recovered Sales Terms do not specifically identify USDon as a security. Accordingly, neither apparent-payment-stablecoin nor excluded-security is established on the available evidence.

genius.notes: USDon is a separately described dollar-backed settlement token, not automatically covered by the security classification of Ondo Stocks tracker certificates. The August 2026 monthly Ankura report identifies Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited and includes USDon liabilities, supporting the issuer string; it reconciles aggregate Stocks, USDY and USDon collateral without a segregated USDon reserve schedule or stand-alone USDon monthly assurance. reserveDisclosurePresent is issuer-level backing/transparency evidence, not independent token-specific assurance. The published conversion policy is 1:1 USDon/USDC subject to liquidity; it does not establish direct 1:1 fiat redemption, and wire-dollar redemptions are not supported. U.S.-person exclusions in stock-offering materials do not by themselves decide USDon payment-stablecoin scope. The Treasury August 17, 2026 proposed-rule announcement expects substantive GENIUS effectiveness on January 18, 2027 and the broad unpermitted DASP offer/sale restriction on July 18, 2028; current proposals and SCRC procedures are not issuer approvals. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the scoped October 7 primary-domain searches.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No opened primary source identifies Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited or USDon as an approved GENIUS payment-stablecoin issuer or an approved foreign-exception issuer as of October 7, 2026. The OCC tracker concerns bank licensing and cannot establish PPSI permission; Federal Reserve proposals, Treasury foreign-pathway discussion and SCRC procedural implementation do not authorize this issuer. Register/search absence is bounded negative evidence, not a finding of unlawfulness, absence of a nonpublic application, or inability to qualify later.
